data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Chart.js Visualization Integration
features.description: Integrate Chart.js to display various metrics and data visualizations.
acceptance_criteria: Implement pipeline metrics visualization using Chart.js.
Include cost tracking and success rate charts.
Ensure charts are interactive and visually appealing.

features.title: 8-Stage Pipeline Visualization
features.description: Develop an 8-stage pipeline visualization using Chart.js.
acceptance_criteria: Accurately represent all 8 stages of the pipeline.
Ensure the visualization is clear and easy to understand.
Include interactive elements for user engagement.

features.title: Real-Time Dashboard with Live Metrics
features.description: Implement a real-time dashboard displaying live metrics using Chart.js.
acceptance_criteria: Display LLM cost over time using a line chart.
Show stage completion rates with a bar chart.
Illustrate success rate trends with an area chart.

features.title: Display Real Metrics from Recent Runs
features.description: Showcase actual data from recent runs to demonstrate Artemis's effectiveness.
acceptance_criteria: Include real metrics data in the presentation.
Ensure data is up-to-date and relevant.
Present data in a clear and understandable format.

features.title: HERO Section Development
features.description: Create a HERO section introducing Artemis as an Autonomous AI Development System.
acceptance_criteria: Clearly define 'What is Artemis?' in the HERO section.
Ensure the section is engaging and informative.
Include visuals or animations to enhance understanding.

features.title: Code Quality Metrics Visualization
features.description: Visualize code quality metrics like TDD compliance and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: Create a radar chart to display code quality metrics.
Ensure data accuracy and clarity in the visualization.
Include interactive features for enhanced user interaction.

features.title: Supervisor Integration Visualization
features.description: Show supervisor integration across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Develop a pie chart to represent supervisor integration.
Ensure the chart is accurate and visually appealing.
Include interactive elements for better user experience.

features.title: Auto-Advance and Navigation Controls
features.description: Enable auto-advance functionality and provide navigation controls for the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance at a set interval.
Include navigation controls for manual slide navigation.
Ensure controls are intuitive and responsive.

features.title: HTML Presentation Creation
features.description: Develop a standalone HTML file to showcase Artemis capabilities using Chart.js.
acceptance_criteria: Create a single HTML file with embedded CSS and JavaScript.
Include Chart.js library for data visualization.
Ensure the file is standalone with no external dependencies.

features.title: Professional Design and Transitions
features.description: Incorporate a professional gradient background and smooth slide transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Use a gradient background throughout the presentation.
Implement smooth transitions between slides.
Ensure design consistency and professional appearance.
